	The Van Sales Representative is responsible for achieving sales targets by visiting customers along assigned routes, promoting products, ensuring proper distribution, and maintaining excellent customer service standards.

	We are seeking energetic and customer-focused Van Sales Representatives to drive direct sales and product distribution across assigned routes.
	This role involves selling, delivering products, and building strong customer relationships within designated territories.

Sales &amp; Distribution:


	Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
	Sell, distribute, and deliver products to customers within assigned routes.
	Identify and develop new sales opportunities within the territory.


Customer Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
	Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries, complaints, and requests.

	Ensure proper product display and visibility at customer locations.
	Replenish shelves and maintain agreed planogram standards.

	Manage van stock levels and ensure accurate daily stock reconciliation.
	Apply FIFO (First In, First Out) to prevent product expiry and losses.


Cash Handling &amp; Reporting:


	Collect payments and issue receipts for cash and credit transactions.
	Submit accurate daily reports on sales, customer feedback, and market/competitor activities.


Market Intelligence:


	Monitor competitor activities including pricing, promotions, and new product launches.
	Provide feedback and suggestions to management for market improvement and product development.


Compliance &amp; Vehicle Management:


	Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and operational procedures.
	Maintain assigned vehicle in good working condition and ensure timely servicing.


Requirements


	Minimum of NCE, Diploma, HD, or HND (Bachelor&rsquo;s degree is an added advantage).
	1&ndash;2 years of experience in sales, preferably in FMCG or related industries.

	Basic knowledge of merchandising, distribution, and field sales operations.





Compensation &amp; Benefits


	Competitive base salary: N120,000.00 Gross Monthly
	Sales commission and performance incentives
	On-the-job training and continuous support
	Growth opportunities within the organization.

 Job Position: Van  Sales Representative 

Job Locations: Abuja; Agbado / Badagry / Surulere / Mushin / Ojo / Ajah / Ibeju Lekki, and Sangotedo - Lagos; Sango Ota - Ogun; Owerri - Imo; Kano; Katsina; Makurdi and Otukpo - Benue; Nasarawa; Kogi; Adamawa; Bauchi; Plateau; Anambra; Enugu; Delta; Bayelsa; Cross River; Ondo; Oyo; and Akwa Ibom
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Financial Services

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Van Sales Representative is responsible for achieving sales targets by visiting customers along assigned routes, promoting products, ensuring proper distribution, and maintaining excellent customer service standards.
	The role combines sales, delivery, merchandising, and basic inventory management.


Description


	We are seeking energetic and customer-focused Van Sales Representatives to drive direct sales and product distribution across assigned routes.
	This role involves selling, delivering products, and building strong customer relationships within designated territories.


Key Responsibilities
Sales & Distribution:


	Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
	Sell, distribute, and deliver products to customers within assigned routes.
	Identify and develop new sales opportunities within the territory.


Customer Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
	Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries, complaints, and requests.


Merchandising:


	Ensure proper product display and visibility at customer locations.
	Replenish shelves and maintain agreed planogram standards.


Inventory Management:


	Manage van stock levels and ensure accurate daily stock reconciliation.
	Apply FIFO (First In, First Out) to prevent product expiry and losses.


Cash Handling & Reporting:


	Collect payments and issue receipts for cash and credit transactions.
	Submit accurate daily reports on sales, customer feedback, and market/competitor activities.


Market Intelligence:


	Monitor competitor activities including pricing, promotions, and new product launches.
	Provide feedback and suggestions to management for market improvement and product development.


Compliance & Vehicle Management:


	Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and operational procedures.
	Maintain assigned vehicle in good working condition and ensure timely servicing.


Requirements


	Minimum of NCE, Diploma, HD, or HND (Bachelor’s degree is an added advantage).
	1–2 years of experience in sales, preferably in FMCG or related industries.
	Minimum of 5 years of driving experience.
	A Valid driver’s license is required (Important)
	Strong communication and negotiation skills.
	Good numerical ability and reporting skills.
	Basic knowledge of merchandising, distribution, and field sales operations.





Compensation & Benefits


	Competitive base salary: N120,000.00 Gross Monthly
	Sales commission and performance incentives
	On-the-job training and continuous support
	Growth opportunities within the organization.

Operations Manager Job at DBreeze Protection Services Limited




        
    

        
        DBreeze Protection Services Limited is into security solution and services with over ten years experience.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Manager 

Job Locations: Lekki, Ajah, Sangotedo and Ibeju Lekki Axis - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking to employ an Operations Manager to lead the administration and strategic development of physical security services across client sites in Lagos.
	This role involves designing security systems, evaluating security protocols, managing equipment maintenance, and overseeing the recruitment and deployment of security personnel.
	The ideal candidate will balance operational excellence with strategic business development, building networks that generate new opportunities while ensuring the highest standards of professional security service delivery.


Responsibilities


	Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for physical security administration including key management, surveillance systems, alarm monitoring, electronic access controls, fire safety protocols, and motor vehicle inspection procedures
	Conduct regular security evaluations and assessments at client sites, ensuring all security equipment is properly maintained and functioning optimally
	Identify current and future security needs, providing data-driven recommendations for process improvements and operational enhancements
	Design and implement systems and processes that support business growth and enable new service opportunities
	Support the recruitment and selection process for security operatives in alignment with organizational policies and compliance standards
	Coordinate the strategic deployment and redeployment of security operatives based on client requirements and operational demands
	Maintain and develop professional networks with clients, industry partners, and stakeholders to identify and pursue new business opportunities
	Ensure clear communication with teams across all client sites within the region with clear feedback to management as required.


Requirements


	A Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent in relevant field from an accredited University.
	Proven experience of a minimum of 5 years as an operations manager within the security services industry or related fields
	Professional Qualifications - Master’s in Business Administration, Project Management Professional (PMP), Professional Certifications in Security Management Systems
	Excellent knowledge of physical security systems including surveillance, access control, alarm monitoring, and fire safety protocols
	Demonstrated ability to conduct security assessments and develop strategic recommendations for operational improvements
	Excellent leadership skills with experience managing recruitment, training, and deployment of security personnel
	Business development acumen with ability to identify opportunities and build professional networks
	Exceptional organizational and coordination abilities to manage multiple client sites simultaneously
	Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with ability to engage stakeholders at all levels
	Experience developing standard operating procedures and compliance frameworks.


Benefits


	Salary: N500,000 monthly.
	Opportunity to shape security operations across diverse client portfolios in Lagos
	Professional development in a growing security services organization
	Collaborative work environment with leadership visibility
	Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application and an updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Instrumentation Engineer",
  "description": "Raybond Technical Limited is a fully indigenous Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Commissioning (EPCIC) service provider, delivering integrated technical solutions across Nigeria and beyond. With over a decade of operational excellence, we serve critical sectors including Oil &amp; Gas, Power, Mining, Cement, FMCG, and Heavy Industries

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Instrumentation Engineer&nbsp;

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	This role requires a combination of engineering knowledge, practical field experience, equipment application knowledge and client-facing technical capability.
	The successful candidate will work with clients, OEMs, suppliers, contractors and Raybond&#39;s internal commercial and engineering teams to understand technical requirements, recommend suitable instrumentation and control solutions, support equipment selection and procurement, and ensure successful installation, commissioning and after-sales support.


Key Responsibilities
Instrumentation &amp; Control Engineering:


	Provide technical engineering support for instrumentation, automation and control projects.
	Identify, specify and recommend appropriate industrial instrumentation for client applications.
	Work with pressure, temperature, flow, level, analytical and other process measurement instruments.
	Support the selection and application of sensors, transmitters, switches, controllers, control valves, actuators and related instrumentation.
	Review and interpret P&amp;IDs, instrument datasheets, loop diagrams, equipment manuals and other technical documents.
	Prepare or review instrument specifications, datasheets, equipment schedules and technical documentation.
	Assist with instrumentation and control system design and engineering activities.
	Support the integration of field instrumentation with PLC, SCADA, DCS and other control systems where applicable.


Technical&nbsp;Sales &amp;&nbsp;Business Development Support:


	Work closely with the commercial/business development team to provide technical support during customer engagements.
	Visit customer sites to understand technical requirements and operational challenges.
	Conduct technical discussions with plant engineers, maintenance teams, procurement departments and other client representatives.
	Recommend suitable instrumentation and automation solutions based on the customer&#39;s application, operating conditions and budget.
	Prepare technical inputs for quotations, tenders, proposals and commercial offers.
	Review customer specifications and develop appropriate technical solutions.
	Assist in preparing technical bid evaluations and equipment comparisons.
	Support the identification of new business opportunities relating to instrumentation, automation, control and industrial equipment.
	Participate in product presentations, technical demonstrations and customer meetings.
	Maintain strong technical relationships with clients and OEM partners.


Equipment Supply &amp; OEM Coordination:


	Support the supply of instrumentation, automation and control equipment from Raybond&#39;s OEM and manufacturing partners.
	Review OEM catalogues, technical specifications and product documentation.
	Liaise with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain technical information, drawings, quotations and product recommendations.
	Assist in selecting equipment that meets client specifications and application requirements.
	Review vendor technical documentation before equipment delivery.
	Provide technical clarification to clients regarding supplied equipment.
	Develop sufficient product knowledge to confidently represent Raybond&#39;s instrumentation and automation product portfolio.


Installation &amp; Commissioning:


	Provide technical supervision and support during installation of instrumentation and control equipment.
	Ensure instruments are installed in accordance with approved drawings, manufacturer recommendations and project specifications.
	Participate in instrument calibration, loop checking, functional testing and commissioning.
	Assist with testing and commissioning of control valves, sensors, transmitters and other instrumentation.
	Identify and resolve installation and commissioning issues.
	Prepare commissioning records, inspection reports, test sheets and punch lists.
	Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, process and other engineering teams during project execution.
	Support equipment start-up and handover activities.


Maintenance &amp; Troubleshooting:


	Provide preventive and corrective maintenance support for instrumentation and control equipment supplied or serviced by Raybond.
	Diagnose instrumentation faults and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
	Troubleshoot faulty sensors, transmitters, control valves, controllers and related equipment.
	Carry out or support instrument calibration and verification.
	Assist clients in identifying the root cause of recurring instrumentation failures.
	Recommend equipment replacement, upgrade or modernization where required.
	Provide technical support during emergency breakdowns and plant maintenance activities.
	Prepare maintenance reports and technical recommendations.


Site Survey &amp; Technical Assessment:


	Conduct site visits and technical surveys at customer facilities.
	Assess existing instrumentation, automation and control systems.
	Identify obsolete, damaged, inefficient or inadequate instrumentation.
	Gather technical information required for equipment selection and project proposals.
	Take relevant measurements and collect equipment specifications from site.
	Prepare site survey reports and recommendations.
	Identify opportunities for system improvement, equipment replacement, automation and process optimization.


Project Execution:


	Support the Engineering Team in planning and executing instrumentation-related projects.
	Develop project-specific technical documentation.
	Monitor instrumentation activities against project schedules.
	Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers and OEMs.
	Ensure technical deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.
	Participate in project meetings and provide technical updates.
	Assist with project documentation, handover packages and close-out activities.


Client &amp; After-Sales Technical Support:


	Provide professional technical support to Raybond customers after equipment delivery and installation.
	Explain equipment operation and maintenance requirements to customers.
	Provide basic user training where required.
	Support customers with troubleshooting and technical queries.
	Follow up on equipment performance and customer satisfaction.
	Recommend spare parts and maintenance requirements.
	Maintain accurate records of customer technical issues and resolutions.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Instrumentation Engineering and related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in instrumentation, automation, control systems, industrial equipment, maintenance or engineering services.
	Practical experience in industrial/process environments is strongly preferred.
	Experience in oil &amp; gas, cement, manufacturing, mining, power, water treatment or other process industries will be an advantage.
	Experience in equipment supply, installation and commissioning will be an added advantage.
	Experience dealing with OEMs, industrial suppliers and end-user customers is desirable.

Business Development Officer Job at Lightread Consulting




        
    

        
        Lightread Consulting - Our client is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Officer

Job Location: Sangotedo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	Our client is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Business Developer Officer to identify new opportunities, build strong partnerships, and contribute to the overall growth of Wabqas Autos.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Identify and pursue new business opportunities and markets.
	Develop and maintain strong relationships with dealers, partners and clients.
	Promote and represent Wabqas Autos products and services.
	Achieve sales targets and contribute to business growth.
	Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities.
	Prepare reports and provide insights to support business decisions.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
	1–3 years of experience in business development, sales or related role.
	Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
	Self-motivated, goal-oriented and ability to work independently.
	Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of automotive industry is a plus.


What We Offer


	Competitive Salary : N120,000 - N200,000 per month with Performance Incentives
	Career Growth in a Fast-Paced Environment
	Professional Development and Training Opportunities
	Collaborative & Supportive Team Culture.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Application Question(s)


	Which area in Lagos do you reside in?
	What's your salary expectation?
